Spanish clubs have won the European Cup or Champions League 20 times. Which countries rule Europe's biggest club trophy?

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ By country of club: Spain 20, the UK 16 (England 15, Scotland 1), Italy 12, Germany 8, the Netherlands 6, Portugal 4, France 3. Romania and Serbia have 1 each. Data: Wikipedia (Oct 2026).
2/ Real Madrid alone have 15 titles. AC Milan have 7, Bayern Munich and Liverpool 6 each, Barcelona 5.
3/ Romania's title is Steaua Bucharest in 1986. Serbia's is Red Star Belgrade in 1991, when the club played for Yugoslavia.
4/ Only nine countries on this map have a winner. Most of Europe has never had a club win it.
Spain, England and Italy have 47 of the titles on this map between them. Which country's drought surprises you most? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
